excerpt.zh: [From.GetPlanetMoon]并非气候宜人之地，但如果我们最初的侦测结果无误，它上面可能有一些珍贵资源。
excerpt.en: The [From.GetPlanetMoon] is not the most welcoming of places, but if our initial scans are any indication it could hold some valuable resources.

texts.zh:
扫描结果显示，[From.GetPlanetMoon]的地表下拥有高浓度的天然气。这种丰厚的资源非常高效节能，可以大大增加地表设施的能源产出。

它带来的好处远比对环境造成的破坏要大。
texts.en:
Scans of the [From.GetPlanetMoon] has unveiled dense deposits of natural gases underneath the surface. The rich resource is extremely energy efficient and would greatly increase the energy output of our surface production.

The potential gain this would serve to us because heavily outweighs any damage that could be caused to the environment.

texts.zh:
扫描结果显示，[From.GetPlanetMoon]的地表下拥有高浓度的天然气。这种丰厚的资源非常高效节能，可以大大增加地表设施的能源产出。

然而，这些资源将会很快耗尽，因为储量稀少、体积较小。
texts.en:
Scans of the [From.GetPlanetMoon] has unveiled dense deposits of natural gases underneath the surface. The rich resource is extremely energy efficient and would greatly increase the energy output of our surface production.

However, using these resources would deplete them rather quickly, as the deposits are rare and small in size.

summary.text:
# 干燥的废土 / Arid Wastes

- 分类 Category：深空异闻 Exploration (C3)

## 如何开始 How it starts

- 3级异常；在干旱行星上以权重3生成。  
  Level-3 anomaly; spawn weight 3 on arid planets.

## 剧情脉络 Story outline

- 4170“易燃性资源”：地下丰富的天然气（行星获“富含气体”修正与两个冰冻气湖资源点）；唯物主义帝国的文本强调收益大于环境代价。  
  4170 "Volatile Resources": rich gas deposits (gas-rich modifier and two frozen gas lakes); materialist text stresses gain over environmental cost.

## 分支与结局 Branches and outcomes

- 单一结果；原脚本中“负责任开采”选项已被注释掉。  
  Single outcome; a "responsible mining" option is commented out in the script.

## 条件与文明差异 Conditions and variants

- 无特别差异。  
  No notable variants.
